planets.name: TOI-2049 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-2049 with a 5.3-day year, found in 2026.

text.card: TOI-2049 b crosses its star every 5.3 days and is 1.5 times as wide as Jupiter, found in 2026.
text.introduction: TOI-2049 b transits TOI-2049 every 5.3 days and is 1.5 times as wide as Jupiter. Orbit and size follow Guenther et al. 2026's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname GUENTHER_ET_AL_2026): pl_orbper 5.303468, pl_radj 1.485, pl_bmassj 1.53
